info.title: Group CC2 Recruitment API
info.description: REST API for the Online Job Recruitment Platform. Operations requiring authentication use an Authorization header with a Bearer JWT. Public registration cannot create ADMIN accounts.

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Registration, login, password changes, and password recovery

tags.name: Users
tags.description: User accounts, employer upgrade requests, and administrator account operations

tags.name: Application
tags.description: Submit applications and review applications for employer-owned jobs

tags.name: Company
tags.description: Manage companies owned by the authenticated employer

tags.name: Shortlisting
tags.description: Shortlist applications and access immutable retained candidate history

tags.name: Profile
tags.description: Manage job seeker profiles and private documents

get.description: Returns the profile belonging to the authenticated JOB_SEEKER. Requires a bearer token.

401.description: A valid bearer token is required.

403.description: The caller is not permitted to access a profile.

put.description: Creates or replaces the authenticated JOB_SEEKER's profile using the request body. Requires a bearer token.

requestBody.description: Profile display name and optional contact details.

example.biography: Backend developer with five years of experience.

400.description: Request body is malformed or fails validation.

401.description: A valid bearer token is required.

403.description: The caller is not permitted to update a profile.

get.description: Returns the job identified by jobId. Employers can view their own jobs; job seekers can view active jobs. Requires a bearer token.

401.description: A valid bearer token is required.

403.description: The caller is not permitted to view jobs.

404.description: Job was not found or is not visible to this caller.

put.description: Replaces jobId's details when the job and selected company belong to the authenticated EMPLOYER. Requires a bearer token.

400.description: Request body is malformed, fails validation, or dueDate is not after today.

401.description: A valid bearer token is required.

403.description: The caller does not have the EMPLOYER role.

404.description: Job or owned company was not found.

delete.description: Deletes jobId if it belongs to the authenticated EMPLOYER. Requires a bearer token.

401.description: A valid bearer token is required.

403.description: The caller does not have the EMPLOYER role.

404.description: Job was not found for this employer.

409.description: Job has submitted applications and cannot be deleted.

get.description: Returns the company identified by companyId if owned by the authenticated EMPLOYER. Requires a bearer token.

401.description: A valid bearer token is required.

403.description: The caller is not an active employer.

404.description: Company was not found for this employer.

put.description: Replaces company details for companyId if it is owned by the authenticated EMPLOYER. Requires a bearer token.

requestBody.description: Company name and optional company details.

400.description: Request body is malformed or fails validation.

401.description: A valid bearer token is required.

403.description: The caller is not an active employer.

404.description: Company was not found for this employer.

409.description: A company with this name already exists for the employer.

get.description: Returns private documents belonging to the authenticated JOB_SEEKER. Requires a bearer token.

401.description: A valid bearer token is required.

403.description: The caller is not permitted to access documents.

post.description: Uploads a private PDF document for the authenticated JOB_SEEKER using multipart form data. Files must be valid PDFs no larger than 5 MiB. Requires a bearer token.

requestBody.description: Multipart file part named file; PDF, maximum 5 MiB.

400.description: File is missing, invalid, or request is malformed.

401.description: A valid bearer token is required.

403.description: The caller is not permitted to upload documents.

413.description: File exceeds the configured upload limit.

get.description: Returns a page of active, non-expired jobs to a JOB_SEEKER. Requires a bearer token. Page defaults to 0 and size to 20; results are sorted newest first.

200.description: Returns a page of matching jobs.

401.description: A valid bearer token is required.

403.description: The caller does not have the JOB_SEEKER role.

post.description: Creates a job posting for a company owned by the authenticated EMPLOYER. Requires a bearer token.

requestBody.description: Job details. The employer identity comes from the bearer token.

201.description: Job created; returns the posting and its location header.

400.description: Request body is malformed, fails validation, or dueDate is not after today.

401.description: A valid bearer token is required.

403.description: The caller does not have the EMPLOYER role.

404.description: The company was not found for this employer.

get.description: Returns upgrade requests submitted by the authenticated user. Requires a bearer token.

401.description: A valid bearer token is required.

403.description: The account is not permitted to view requests.

post.description: Submits company details as JSON in the application multipart part and a required PDF registration document in the document part. Requires a JOB_SEEKER bearer token.

400.description: Multipart parts are malformed or fail validation.

401.description: A valid bearer token is required.

403.description: The account is not permitted to submit this request.

409.description: An upgrade request cannot be submitted in the account's current state.

get.description: Returns upgrade requests submitted by the authenticated user. Requires a bearer token.

401.description: A valid bearer token is required.

403.description: The account is not permitted to view requests.

post.description: Submits company details as JSON in the application multipart part and a required PDF registration document in the document part. Requires a JOB_SEEKER bearer token.

400.description: Multipart parts are malformed or fail validation.

401.description: A valid bearer token is required.

403.description: The account is not permitted to submit this request.

409.description: An upgrade request cannot be submitted in the account's current state.

get.description: Returns companies owned by the authenticated EMPLOYER. Requires a bearer token.

401.description: A valid bearer token is required.

403.description: The caller is not an active employer.

post.description: Creates a company owned by the authenticated EMPLOYER. Requires a bearer token.

requestBody.description: Company name and optional company details.

201.description: Company created; returns the company details.

400.description: Request body is malformed or fails validation.

401.description: A valid bearer token is required.

403.description: The caller is not an active employer.

409.description: A company with this name already exists for the employer.

post.description: Sets a new password using a valid one-time reset token.

requestBody.description: Reset token and new password (12 to 72 characters).

400.description: Request body is malformed, fails validation, or the reset token is invalid.

post.description: Creates a new account. Public registration accepts the JOB_SEEKER role only; credentials must satisfy the request validation rules.

requestBody.description: Email, password, and optional JOB_SEEKER role.

201.description: Account created; returns the registered account details.

400.description: Request body is malformed or fails validation.

post.description: Invalidates the authenticated account's current token version. Requires a valid bearer token.

401.description: A valid bearer token is required.

post.description: Authenticates an account with its email and password and returns a bearer token.

200.description: Credentials accepted; returns the token response.

400.description: Request body is malformed or fails validation.

401.description: Credentials are invalid.

post.description: Accepts an account email and starts the password recovery flow. Returns a response that does not disclose whether the account exists.

400.description: Request body is malformed or fails validation.

post.description: Changes the authenticated account password after verifying the current password. Requires a valid bearer token.

requestBody.description: Current password and new password (12 to 72 characters).

400.description: Request body is malformed, fails validation, or the new password is not accepted.

401.description: A valid bearer token is required or the current password is invalid.

get.description: Returns applications submitted by the authenticated job seeker. Requires a JOB_SEEKER bearer token.

401.description: A valid bearer token is required.

403.description: The caller is not permitted to view applications.

post.description: Creates a PENDING application for the authenticated job seeker. Applicant identity, application ID, status, and timestamps are assigned by the server. Each application requires its own PDF CV (maximum 5 MiB) and plain text cover letter (maximum 10,000 characters).

requestBody.description: Multipart form with a jobId and the PDF CV to submit for this application. The CV is preserved for this application and does not replace profile documents.

400.description: Missing job ID/CV, PROFILE_INCOMPLETE, or invalid CV

413.description: CV exceeds the 5 MiB upload limit

401.description: Authentication is required

403.description: Only active job seekers may apply

409.description: Job is not accepting applications or this seeker already applied

get.description: Returns user accounts visible to the authenticated administrator. Requires an ADMIN bearer token.

401.description: A valid bearer token is required

403.description: The caller must have the ADMIN role

post.summary: Create a job seeker or employer account
post.description: Creates an active account for the selected role. Only JOB_SEEKER and EMPLOYER are allowed; ADMIN accounts must use the role-assignment workflow.

400.description: The email, password, or role is invalid.

401.description: A valid bearer token is required

403.description: The caller must have the ADMIN role

patch.description: Closes jobId if it belongs to the authenticated EMPLOYER. Closing an already closed job returns it unchanged. Requires a bearer token.

401.description: A valid bearer token is required.

403.description: The caller does not have the EMPLOYER role.

404.description: Job was not found for this employer.

patch.description: Sets the status of an application belonging to an authenticated employer's job. Requires an EMPLOYER bearer token.

400.description: Request body is malformed or status is invalid.

401.description: A valid bearer token is required.

403.description: The caller is not permitted to update this application.

409.description: The requested status transition is not allowed.

get.description: Returns the application identified by applicationId if it belongs to the authenticated job seeker. Requires a JOB_SEEKER bearer token.

401.description: A valid bearer token is required.

403.description: The caller is not permitted to view this application.

delete.description: Logical withdrawal retains application, CV, and decision history. Repeating withdrawal succeeds with 204. Only PENDING applications may be withdrawn.

patch.description: Updates the cover letter while the related job is still accepting applications.

400.description: Invalid cover letter

patch.description: Suspends the account identified by id. Requires an ADMIN bearer token.

401.description: A valid bearer token is required

403.description: The caller must have the ADMIN role

patch.description: Promotes the user identified by id to administrator. Requires an ADMIN bearer token.

requestBody.description: The only supported role value is ADMIN.

400.description: Request body is malformed or role is not ADMIN.

401.description: A valid bearer token is required

403.description: The caller must have the ADMIN role

patch.description: Removes the account identified by id. Requires an ADMIN bearer token.

200.description: Returns the resulting user account representation.

401.description: A valid bearer token is required

403.description: The caller must have the ADMIN role

patch.description: Rejects requestId with a reason. Requires an ADMIN bearer token.

parameters.name: requestId
parameters.description: UUID of the employer upgrade request.

example.reason: Business details could not be verified.

400.description: Request body is malformed or fails validation.

401.description: A valid bearer token is required.

403.description: The caller must have the ADMIN role.

patch.description: Approves requestId and upgrades the applicant to employer. Requires an ADMIN bearer token.

parameters.name: requestId
parameters.description: UUID of the employer upgrade request.

401.description: A valid bearer token is required.

403.description: The caller must have the ADMIN role.

get.description: Returns the account associated with the authenticated bearer token.

200.description: Returns the authenticated user's account details.

401.description: A valid bearer token is required.

403.description: The account is not permitted to access this resource.

404.description: The authenticated account was not found.

get.description: Returns download details for documentId if it belongs to the authenticated JOB_SEEKER. Requires a bearer token.

401.description: A valid bearer token is required.

403.description: The caller is not permitted to download this document.

get.description: Returns retained shortlist records for jobs owned by the authenticated employer. Records remain available after application withdrawal, removal from active application views, or job expiry.
Returns one immutable shortlist record when it belongs to a job owned by the authenticated employer.
Returns a page of the authenticated EMPLOYER's job postings. Requires a bearer token. Page defaults to 0 and size to 20; results are sorted newest first.

200.description: Returns a page of the employer's jobs.

400.description: Status query parameter has an invalid value.

401.description: A valid bearer token is required.

403.description: The caller does not have the EMPLOYER role.

get.description: Returns applications for jobs owned by the authenticated EMPLOYER, including applicant display names and the metadata for each application's submitted CV. Requires a bearer token.

parameters.name: jobId
parameters.description: Optional UUID to filter applications by job.

401.description: A valid bearer token is required.

403.description: The caller is not permitted to review applications.

400.description: A query parameter has an invalid format.

get.summary: Get an application for my jobs
get.description: Returns the application and its submitted CV metadata when it belongs to one of the authenticated employer's jobs. Requires an EMPLOYER bearer token.

401.description: A valid bearer token is required.

403.description: The caller is not permitted to access this application.

get.description: Returns the profile for an application belonging to one of the authenticated employer's jobs.
Returns a short-lived private download link for the CV submitted with this application. Only the employer that owns the application's job may request it.

401.description: A valid bearer token is required.

403.description: The caller is not authorized for this job.

get.description: Returns only the authenticated applicant's submission and its status.

404.description: Submission not found for this applicant.

403.description: JOB_SEEKER or EMPLOYER role required.

get.description: Returns the account associated with the valid bearer token.

401.description: A valid bearer token is required.

get.description: Returns the account identified by id. Requires an ADMIN bearer token.

401.description: A valid bearer token is required

403.description: The caller must have the ADMIN role

get.description: Returns upgrade requests awaiting an administrator decision. Requires an ADMIN bearer token.

401.description: A valid bearer token is required.

403.description: The caller must have the ADMIN role.

get.description: Returns company details and review status. ADMIN bearer token required.

403.description: ADMIN role required.

get.summary: Get a temporary link to a company registration document
get.description: Returns a short lived signed URL. ADMIN bearer token required.

403.description: ADMIN role required.

delete.description: Deletes documentId if it belongs to the authenticated JOB_SEEKER. Requires a bearer token.

400.description: A document referenced by a submitted application cannot be deleted.

401.description: A valid bearer token is required.

403.description: The caller is not permitted to delete this document.

get.description: Public readiness check. Component details are disabled.

message.example: must be a valid email address

fullName.description: Full legal name; defaults to displayName when omitted

biography.example: Backend developer with five years of experience.

companyId.description: Company represented by the authenticated employer

description.example: Build and maintain recruitment platform services.

dueDate.description: Date after which applications are no longer accepted

document.description: Private company registration proof, PDF only, maximum 5 MiB.

role.description: Only JOB_SEEKER is permitted during public registration

ApplicationSubmissionRequest.description: Submit one application with its own PDF CV.

cv.description: PDF CV for this application (maximum 5 MiB).

ApiError.description: Safe, consistent error response returned by the API.

message.example: The requested resource was not found.

UserResponse.description: Safe user identity response. Credential data is never returned.

BadRequest.description: Invalid request; see the shared error schema.

Unauthorized.description: Authentication is required or credentials are invalid.

NotFound.description: The requested resource was not found.

Conflict.description: The request conflicts with existing state.

TooManyRequests.description: The request rate limit was exceeded.

bearerAuth.description: Send a signed access token as: Authorization: Bearer <token>
